claims: The Men’s NCAA Tournament bracket will be revealed at 6 p.m. ET on CBS.
The Women’s NCAA Tournament bracket will be revealed at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN.
The Men’s NCAA Tournament can be streamed via Paramount+.
The Women’s NCAA Tournament can be streamed via ESPN+.
Men’s Bracket Reveal is at 6:00 p.m. ET on CBS/Paramount+.
Women’s Bracket Reveal is at 8:00 p.m. ET on ESPN.
The format consists of one-hour shows revealing all 68 teams, seeds, and matchups for both tournaments.
Streaming options include March Madness Live, ESPN app, Paramount+, Hulu + Live TV, FuboTV, and DirecTV.
First Four games begin on March 17-18.
